words.example: They will cancel the brown-bag if fewer than six people reply.
words.exampleZh: 如果回复不到六人，午餐分享会就会取消。

words.example: Can you confirm the interpreter before we promise the family?
words.exampleZh: 答应家属之前，你能先确认翻译在吗？

words.example: The reminder about badges will go on the notice board today.
words.exampleZh: 关于工牌的提醒今天会贴到公告栏上。

words.example: An announcement about the water shutdown is going out at noon.
words.exampleZh: 停水通知中午会发出去。

words.example: The memo asks us to stop leaving patient lists on the counter.
words.exampleZh: 内部备忘要求我们不要把患者名单留在台面上。

words.example: The infusion pump on bed six lost its drug library overnight.
words.exampleZh: 六床的输液泵夜里把药库弄丢了。

words.example: The vital monitor in ICU bay three stopped sending heart rates.
words.exampleZh: 重症三床的生命体征监护仪不再上传心率。

words.example: This barcode scanner misreads wristbands under the ward lights.
words.exampleZh: 这把条码扫描枪在病区灯光下会扫错腕带。

words.example: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) on the infusion pump failed at the door.
words.exampleZh: 这台输液泵上的RFID（射频识别）在门口没有读到。

words.meaning: 实时定位系统（Real-Time Location System）
words.example: RTLS (Real-Time Location System) still shows the wheelchair in the old clinic.
words.exampleZh: RTLS（实时定位系统）还显示那台轮椅在旧门诊。
